name: Modu default
note: Modu's own default regex, SillyTavern regex-script shape. Display only (markdownOnly: true, placement 2 = his replies): they change what the screen shows, never the stored chat or the prompt. Markers ⟦face:x⟧ and ⟦sticker:x⟧ are drawn by the chat view.

scripts.scriptName: Hide state, promise and status tags
scripts.note: Tags the app reads stay out of the bubbles.
The mood tag becomes a face marker; the chat shows it as his mood sticker and the body's face.
A sticker tag becomes a sticker marker, drawn as its own bubble. Only letters, digits, Chinese characters, _ and - pass, so no markup reaches the view.

After a sentence end inside a line, start a new bubble. ASCII ! and ? count only before a space or a Chinese character, so links stay whole; nothing is split when an * follows on the line, so *action* spans stay whole (the app's own splitter handles them). Linear: a run of punctuation is matched once.
